paragraphs.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, [which is] your spiritual service.
paragraphs.original: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς, ἀδελφοί, διὰ τῶν οἰκτιρμῶν τοῦ θεοῦ παραστῆσαι τὰ σώματα ὑμῶν θυσίαν ζῶσαν ἁγίαν εὐάρεστον τῷ θεῷ, τὴν λογικὴν λατρείαν ὑμῶν·
paragraphs.translit: Parakalō oun hymas, adelphoi, dia tōn oiktirmōn tou theou parastēsai ta sōmata hymōn thysian zōsan hagian euareston tō theō, tēn logikēn latreian hymōn·

paragraphs.text: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, and ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
paragraphs.original: καὶ μὴ συσχηματίζεσθε τῷ αἰῶνι τούτῳ, ἀλλὰ μεταμορφοῦσθε τῇ ἀνακαινώσει τοῦ νοός, εἰς τὸ δοκιμάζειν ὑμᾶς τί τὸ θέλημα τοῦ θεοῦ, τὸ ἀγαθὸν καὶ εὐάρεστον καὶ τέλειον.
paragraphs.translit: kai mē syschēmatizesthe tō aiōni toutō, alla metamorphousthe tē anakainōsei tou noos, eis to dokimazein hymas ti to thelēma tou theou, to agathon kai euareston kai teleion.

paragraphs.text: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think as to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to each man a measure of faith.
paragraphs.original: Λέγω γὰρ διὰ τῆς χάριτος τῆς δοθείσης μοι παντὶ τῷ ὄντι ἐν ὑμῖν μὴ ὑπερφρονεῖν παρʼ ὃ δεῖ φρονεῖν, ἀλλὰ φρονεῖν εἰς τὸ σωφρονεῖν, ἑκάστῳ ὡς ὁ θεὸς ἐμέρισεν μέτρον πίστεως.
paragraphs.translit: Legō gar dia tēs charitos tēs dotheisēs moi panti tō onti en hymin mē hyperphronein parʼ ho dei phronein, alla phronein eis to sōphronein, hekastō hōs ho theos emerisen metron pisteōs.

paragraphs.text: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members have not the same office:
paragraphs.original: καθάπερ γὰρ ἐν ἑνὶ σώματι πολλὰ μέλη ἔχομεν, τὰ δὲ μέλη πάντα οὐ τὴν αὐτὴν ἔχει πρᾶξιν,
paragraphs.translit: kathaper gar en heni sōmati polla melē echomen, ta de melē panta ou tēn autēn echei praxin,

paragraphs.text: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and severally members one of another.
paragraphs.original: οὕτως οἱ πολλοὶ ἓν σῶμά ἐσμεν ἐν Χριστῷ, τὸ δὲ καθʼ εἷς ἀλλήλων μέλη.
paragraphs.translit: houtōs hoi polloi hen sōma esmen en Christō, to de kathʼ heis allēlōn melē.

paragraphs.text: And having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, whether prophecy, [let us prophesy] according to the proportion of our faith;
paragraphs.original: ἔχοντες δὲ χαρίσματα κατὰ τὴν χάριν τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν διάφορα, εἴτε προφητείαν κατὰ τὴν ἀναλογίαν τῆς πίστεως,
paragraphs.translit: echontes de charismata kata tēn charin tēn dotheisan hēmin diaphora, eite prophēteian kata tēn analogian tēs pisteōs,

paragraphs.text: or ministry, [let us give ourselves] to our ministry; or he that teacheth, to his teaching;
paragraphs.original: εἴτε διακονίαν ἐν τῇ διακονίᾳ, εἴτε ὁ διδάσκων ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ,
paragraphs.translit: eite diakonian en tē diakonia, eite ho didaskōn en tē didaskalia,

paragraphs.text: or he that exhorteth, to his exhorting: he that giveth, [let him do it] with liberality; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness.
paragraphs.original: εἴτε ὁ παρακαλῶν ἐν τῇ παρακλήσει, ὁ μεταδιδοὺς ἐν ἁπλότητι, ὁ προϊστάμενος ἐν σπουδῇ, ὁ ἐλεῶν ἐν ἱλαρότητι.
paragraphs.translit: eite ho parakalōn en tē paraklēsei, ho metadidous en haplotēti, ho proistamenos en spoudē, ho eleōn en hilarotēti.

paragraphs.text: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
paragraphs.original: Ἡ ἀγάπη ἀνυπόκριτος. ἀποστυγοῦντες τὸ πονηρόν, κολλώμενοι τῷ ἀγαθῷ·
paragraphs.translit: Hē agapē anypokritos. apostygountes to ponēron, kollōmenoi tō agathō·

paragraphs.text: In love of the brethren be tenderly affectioned one to another; in honor preferring one another;
paragraphs.original: τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ εἰς ἀλλήλους φιλόστοργοι, τῇ τιμῇ ἀλλήλους προηγούμενοι,
paragraphs.translit: tē philadelphia eis allēlous philostorgoi, tē timē allēlous proēgoumenoi,

paragraphs.text: in diligence not slothful; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
paragraphs.original: τῇ σπουδῇ μὴ ὀκνηροί, τῷ πνεύματι ζέοντες, τῷ κυρίῳ δουλεύοντες,
paragraphs.translit: tē spoudē mē oknēroi, tō pneumati zeontes, tō kyriō douleuontes,

paragraphs.text: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;
paragraphs.original: τῇ ἐλπίδι χαίροντες, τῇ θλίψει ὑπομένοντες, τῇ προσευχῇ προσκαρτεροῦντες,
paragraphs.translit: tē elpidi chairontes, tē thlipsei hypomenontes, tē proseuchē proskarterountes,

paragraphs.text: communicating to the necessities of the saints; given to hospitality.
paragraphs.original: ταῖς χρείαις τῶν ἁγίων κοινωνοῦντες, τὴν φιλοξενίαν διώκοντες.
paragraphs.translit: tais chreiais tōn hagiōn koinōnountes, tēn philoxenian diōkontes.

paragraphs.text: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.
paragraphs.original: εὐλογεῖτε τοὺς διώκοντας, εὐλογεῖτε καὶ μὴ καταρᾶσθε.
paragraphs.translit: eulogeite tous diōkontas, eulogeite kai mē katarasthe.

paragraphs.text: Rejoice with them that rejoice; weep with them that weep.
paragraphs.original: χαίρειν μετὰ χαιρόντων, κλαίειν μετὰ κλαιόντων.
paragraphs.translit: chairein meta chairontōn, klaiein meta klaiontōn.

paragraphs.text: Be of the same mind one toward another. Set not your mind on high things, but condescend to things that are lowly. Be not wise in your own conceits.
paragraphs.original: τὸ αὐτὸ εἰς ἀλλήλους φρονοῦντες, μὴ τὰ ὑψηλὰ φρονοῦντες ἀλλὰ τοῖς ταπεινοῖς συναπαγόμενοι. μὴ γίνεσθε φρόνιμοι παρʼ ἑαυτοῖς.
paragraphs.translit: to auto eis allēlous phronountes, mē ta hypsēla phronountes alla tois tapeinois synapagomenoi. mē ginesthe phronimoi parʼ heautois.

paragraphs.text: Render to no man evil for evil. Take thought for things honorable in the sight of all men.
paragraphs.original: μηδενὶ κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἀποδιδόντες· προνοούμενοι καλὰ ἐνώπιον πάντων ἀνθρώπων·
paragraphs.translit: mēdeni kakon anti kakou apodidontes· pronooumenoi kala enōpion pantōn anthrōpōn·

paragraphs.text: If it be possible, as much as in you lieth, be at peace with all men.
paragraphs.original: εἰ δυνατόν, τὸ ἐξ ὑμῶν μετὰ πάντων ἀνθρώπων εἰρηνεύοντες·
paragraphs.translit: ei dynaton, to ex hymōn meta pantōn anthrōpōn eirēneuontes·

paragraphs.text: Avenge not yourselves, beloved, but give place unto the wrath [of God]: for it is written, Vengeance belongeth unto me; I will recompense, saith the Lord.
paragraphs.original: μὴ ἑαυτοὺς ἐκδικοῦντες, ἀγαπητοί, ἀλλὰ δότε τόπον τῇ ὀργῇ, γέγραπται γάρ· Ἐμοὶ ἐκδίκησις, ἐγὼ ἀνταποδώσω, λέγει κύριος.
paragraphs.translit: mē heautous ekdikountes, agapētoi, alla dote topon tē orgē, gegraptai gar· Emoi ekdikēsis, egō antapodōsō, legei kyrios.

paragraphs.text: But if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him to drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ ἐὰν πεινᾷ ὁ ἐχθρός σου, ψώμιζε αὐτόν· ἐὰν διψᾷ, πότιζε αὐτόν· τοῦτο γὰρ ποιῶν ἄνθρακας πυρὸς σωρεύσεις ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: alla ean peina ho echthros sou, psōmize auton· ean dipsa, potize auton· touto gar poiōn anthrakas pyros sōreuseis epi tēn kephalēn autou.

paragraphs.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
paragraphs.original: μὴ νικῶ ὑπὸ τοῦ κακοῦ, ἀλλὰ νίκα ἐν τῷ ἀγαθῷ τὸ κακόν.
paragraphs.translit: mē nikō hypo tou kakou, alla nika en tō agathō to kakon.
